compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
After the removal story (anguished-grown-junebug) lands, ten documents still link to `docs/workflow-editor.md` and describe `rebar workflow edit`, BPMN round-tripping, and Node as a build input; ADR 0071 still reads `Proposed`; the changelog carries no breaking entry; and the operator requires the removal SHA recorded on idea epic `yip-gem-teak` (`7013-447f-3084-4241`, "Visual prompt + eval review surface") so the editor can be restored if WS-VISUAL-EVAL is approved. Cites are on origin/main 2e81cb9767c1.

## Approach
Delete the editor doc and every link to it (`scripts/check_docs_index.py --check` resolves inline link targets across `docs/**` and root `*.md`; a dangling link fails it). Rewrite mixed paragraphs; delete editor-only sections. Mark ADR 0071 superseded using the house `- **Status:** <word> (<parenthetical>)` line (example `docs/adr/0103-reconciler-operation-coordination.md:3`); the ADR index `docs/adr/README.md` is generated from titles only by `scripts/gen_adr_index.py:190-237`, so it is untouched. Add the changelog and release-notes entries. Post the restore comment on `yip-gem-teak` and verify it via `rebar show`.

## Scope
- Delete `docs/workflow-editor.md` (171 lines).
- `docs/README.md:79` delete the index line.
- `README.md:169-175` delete the Node/npm bullet; `:213-221` becomes: "The base install runs **scripted** workflows (`rebar workflow new/validate/show/run`) with no extra; **agentic** workflow steps and `rebar review-plan` need `[agents]`. For what the engine is *for*, when to author a workflow vs a bespoke op, the YAML DSL, the three-pass review pattern, and the prompt-library + eval seam, see [docs/workflow-engine.md](docs/workflow-engine.md)."
- `docs/architecture.md:309-316` delete the paragraph.
- `docs/plan-review-gate.md:23-24` -> `> docs [workflow-authoring-v2.md](workflow-authoring-v2.md) (the consolidated `docs/workflow-engine.md``.
- `docs/experiments/workflow-remediation-pocs/README.md:22` -> "`src/rebar/llm/workflow/bpmn.py` + the editor (removed in <S1 sha>; restore recipe on ticket `yip-gem-teak`)." (if the eval-harness epic has already moved this tree to `evals/`, edit it at the new path).
- `docs/workflow-engine.md:20` drop the `[workflow-editor.md](...) (the visual editor),` clause; `:124` delete; `:129-130` -> "[workflow-authoring-v2.md](workflow-authoring-v2.md)."; `:225` delete the bullet.
- `docs/workflow-authoring-v2.md`: `:3` drop "Like the visual editor, this"; `:9-12` -> "that powers the prompt library and the workflow validator; this page covers the *model* the engine consumes."; `:15` drop "so the editor can present a typed palette and"; delete section 1.4 (`:86-108`), headings are literal strings so nothing renumbers; `:150-151` -> "The per-step `model` field is free text, so custom/non-ladder models are allowed."; `:212` drop "the editor inspector and"; `:224` delete the sentence; `:281` delete the sentence; delete section 7 (`:307-316`).
- `docs/adr/0071-editing-prompt-contracts-from-the-editor.md:5-6` -> `- **Status:** Superseded — never implemented; the visual editor it extends was removed on <merge date from git log -1 --format=%cs <S1 sha>> in commit <S1 sha> (epic middle-dowdy-sanddollar). Restore recipe: the comment on ticket `yip-gem-teak` (`7013-447f-3084-4241`).`
- `CHANGELOG.md` under `## [Unreleased]` (`:37`): add a `### Removed` subsection after `### Changed` with the entry: "**BREAKING (pre-1.0): the BPMN visual workflow editor has been removed.** `rebar workflow edit` no longer exists (`new|validate|run|show|status|result` are unchanged and existing `.rebar/workflows/*.yaml` keep running). Removed with it: the modules `rebar.llm.workflow.{editor,editor_server,editor_contracts,bpmn,criterion_preview,prompt_authoring}` and the exports `rebar.llm.workflow.{bpmn_to_ir,ir_to_bpmn,REBAR_MODDLE_DESCRIPTOR}`; the vendored `editor_assets/dist/editor.{js,css}` bundle (~2 MB) that shipped in the wheel; the `REBAR_PREVIEW_TIMEOUT` environment variable and `rebar.config.resolve_preview_timeout`; the `e2e` pytest marker, `tests/e2e/`, and `make e2e-deps`. Node/npm are no longer required to build, test, or develop rebar. ADR 0071 (never implemented) is marked Superseded; the deleted code is restorable from the commit recorded on ticket `yip-gem-teak`."
- `docs/release-notes.md:11` insert above: `## BREAKING (pre-1.0) — visual-editor library surface removed` plus one paragraph naming the dropped `rebar.llm.workflow` exports, `rebar.config.resolve_preview_timeout`, and `REBAR_PREVIEW_TIMEOUT`.
- Comment on `yip-gem-teak` using this template: "Editor removal record (epic middle-dowdy-sanddollar / story anguished-grown-junebug, ADR 0071 never implemented). Removed in commit <S1 full sha> (Gerrit change <n>, merged <YYYY-MM-DD>); parent <S1 sha>^. Deleted: src/rebar/llm/workflow/{editor.py,editor_server.py,editor_contracts.py,bpmn.py,criterion_preview.py,prompt_authoring.py,rebar.moddle.json}; src/rebar/llm/workflow/editor_assets/; tests/e2e/; tests/unit/workflow/test_{bpmn,editor,editor_batch,editor_effective_policy,editor_roundtrip,editor_validate,prompt_authoring}.py; tests/unit/test_criterion_preview.py; tests/unit/test_browser_tier_optout.py; scripts/t5c_calibrate.py; docs/workflow-editor.md (in <this story's sha>). Restore: git checkout <S1 sha>^ -- <paths above>; then re-apply from `git show <S1 sha>`: the `edit` subparser (_cli/_parsers/advanced/workflow.py), `_workflow_edit` (_cli/_workflow_commands.py), `resolve_preview_timeout`, the pyproject `artifacts` force-include, Makefile `e2e-deps`, the CI Node steps; run `npm --prefix src/rebar/llm/workflow/editor_assets ci && npm run build`."
- Untouched (historical): `docs/design/batch-runner-seam.md:181`, `docs/adr/0102-review-discovery-effective-policy.md:38`, `docs/experiments/**` fixtures and corpora.

## Testing
Doc gates: `python scripts/check_docs_index.py --check`, `python scripts/gen_adr_index.py --check`, `python scripts/check_adr_numbers.py`, `python scripts/check_readme_quickstart.py`. The ticket record is verified by reading the store.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `git ls-files docs/workflow-editor.md | wc -l` prints `0`; `git grep -n 'workflow-editor' -- docs README.md CONTRIBUTING.md AGENTS.md .github templates src/rebar/_guides ':!docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/fixtures'` prints nothing.
- [ ] `git grep -n -E 'workflow edit|visual editor|bpmn-js' -- README.md docs/README.md docs/architecture.md docs/workflow-engine.md docs/workflow-authoring-v2.md docs/plan-review-gate.md` prints nothing.
- [ ] `sed -n 5p docs/adr/0071-editing-prompt-contracts-from-the-editor.md` starts with `- **Status:** Superseded — never implemented` and contains the S1 SHA.
- [ ] `grep -c 'BREAKING (pre-1.0): the BPMN visual workflow editor has been removed' CHANGELOG.md` prints `1`; `grep -c 'visual-editor library surface removed' docs/release-notes.md` prints `1`.
- [ ] `python scripts/check_docs_index.py --check && python scripts/gen_adr_index.py --check && python scripts/check_readme_quickstart.py` exit 0.
- [ ] `rebar show yip-gem-teak -o json | grep -c '<S1 full sha>'` prints at least 1, and the same output contains `git checkout <S1 sha>^ --`.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0; the change reaches `Verified +1`.
